76: - **Materiality**: Frosted translucent white card surfaces (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72)`) with a specular top rim highlight (`inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)`), hairline borders (`rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)`), and soft layered drop shadows.

82: - **Materiality**: Frosted dark obsidian cards (`rgba(35, 33, 42, 0.65)`) with specular glass highlights (`inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`), subtle borders (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`), and deep atmospheric shadows.

86: ## 4. Top Floating Chrome & Navigation

92: - Shape: Rounded squircle button (`44px × 44px`, `rounded-[14px]`).
93: - Icon: Minimalist Home mark `[ ⌂ ]`.

96: ### 4.2 Mode Segmented Switch (`top-center`)
97: - Position: Centered horizontally at `top: 20px`.
98: - Shape: Floating pill container (`rounded-full`, height `38px`, padding `3px`).
99: - Options: `[ Chat | Projects ]`.
100:   - **Active Tab**: High-contrast solid pill (`bg-black text-white` in light mode; `bg-white text-black` in dark mode) with spring transition.
101:   - **Inactive Tab**: Ghost text (`text-muted`), hover elevates gently.
102: - Function: Instantly toggles the central workspace between conversational task execution (`Chat`) and structured project file management (`Projects`) with zero page reloads.
103: 
104: ### 4.3 Utility Cluster (`top-right`)
105: - Position: Fixed at `top: 20px`, `right: 24px`.
106: - **Search Pill**:
107:   - Pill button (`height: 38px`, `px: 16px`, `rounded-full`).
108:   - Label: `Search` with subtle magnifying glass icon.
109:   - Trigger: Clicking opens the **Centered Search Overlay** (blurring the background and popping a focused search pill in the viewport center).
110: - **User Avatar**:

112:   - Trigger: Clicking opens the **User Profile & Settings Sheet**.

171: ```

175: - **Surface**:
